title: Alignment of LRMs via Counter-Aligned Few-Shot Conversation Exposure
abstract: arXiv:2609.27763v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) rely on explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and large context windows to achieve strong performance on complex tasks, but these features also introduce new attack surfaces. We show that LRMs' reasoning processes can be systematically steered by prepending counter-aligned few-shot conversations containing explicit CoT traces, leading to unsafe generations on harmful queries and unwarranted refusals on benign ones. We formalize this attack as SRCF (Steering Reasoning via Counter-Aligned Few-shot Conversations) that operates solely through a flexible conversational interface and requires no access to the model's parameters and gradients. translated_title: 通过反向对齐少样本对话暴露实现大型推理模型的对齐
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型（LRMs）依靠显式的思维链（CoT）推理和大上下文窗口在复杂任务上取得优异表现，但这些特性也引入了新的攻击面。我们证明，LRMs 的推理过程可以通过在输入前附加包含显式 CoT 轨迹的反向对齐少样本对话而被系统性引导，导致其在有害查询上生成不安全内容，而在良性查询上产生不当拒绝。我们将该攻击形式化为 SRCF（通过反向对齐少样本对话引导推理），它仅通过灵活的对话接口即可运作，无需访问模型参数和梯度。我们的核心洞察是，SRCF 利用了一个对抗性泛化问题，该问题会引发表示漂移，使良性输入与有害输入的表示朝相似方向偏移。这一观察启发我们提出了后训练防御方法 ARCF（通过……对齐表示）。
tldr: 本文揭示了大型推理模型的推理过程可被注入含显式思维链的反向对齐少样本对话系统性引导（SRCF 攻击），其根源是对抗性泛化导致的表示漂移，并据此提出了后训练防御方法 ARCF。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the reasoning of Large Reasoning Models can be systematically steered by prepending counter-aligned few-shot conversations with explicit CoT traces (the SRCF attack), driven by adversarial generalization-induced representation drift, and proposes a post-training defense called ARCF.
